newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank to offer 5-day rrp at 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank to offer 5-day rrp at 13 pct.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank will offer on Friday five-day reverse repos at a rate of 13.0 percent, Central Bank Treasurer Sergio Edeza said on Thursday.
This is to align the rate with the increase in the overnight borrowing rate to 13 from 12 percent late Thursday.
The Central Bank had raised its overnight borrowing rate twice to a total of 1.75 percentage points in the day to protect the peso from speculation arising from the problems in the Thai baht.
Asked by Reuters whether there would be more moves to raise its rate, Edeza said: "We will know that after what happens to the market tomorrow but let this be a warning to the market."
Edeza said the Central Bank would also raise its overnight lending rate tomorrow to 14 percent from 13.
